text:
A sample contains 0.0016g of a radioactive isotope.
After 4.0 hours the mass of the radioactive isotope in the sample falls to 0.00080g.
What is the half-life of the radioactive isotope?
A
2.0 hours
B
4.0 hours
C
8.0 hours
D
16 hours
subject: Physics
